title: Crew pill and session row disagree during route save
detail: Two independent pill classifications hide the Chief session while saving its route. Save Harness and model for an in-session Chief on its unslotted launch desktop. While the response is pending, the crew pill shows busy setup and the desktop list still suppresses the session row using a separate classification. Derive row suppression from the same crew entry model as rendering. Independently source-confirmed on s-zy7kp3.
